method: Go AST counts, physical lines including comments/blank lines; selector analysis syntactic, not whole-program type inference

summary.notes: Source-file count is not service count; these41 production files form one Go package and one service object. Cross-file selector counts are syntactic evidence of coupling, not independent runtime service calls.

semantic_distinctions.behavior: capacity, occupancy, room moderation and votes; room traffic excluded from offline Pending
community/forum posts and optional links to rooms; different from private chat groups

coupling_evidence.finding: account owns credential snapshot plus deliveryGate; session owns authentication, presence, room membership, contact revision, transient activities, durable inflight reservation and own-message cursor, responseGate and emoticon refresh. These are concurrent shared state, not just common DTOs.
Application holds one state mutex, all accounts/sessions, composite124-method repository, packet delivery map, room kick ballots/cooldowns and operator role set.

Handle acquires account deliveryGate before state mutex for personal-block opcode417; ordinary native operations hold Application.mu while dispatching use cases. Package extraction alone must not alter this lock order.
Persisting block invokes cancelBlockedDeliveries; direct effects across contact graph and chat queues enforce no incoming messages after a block.

Modern SendChatMessage already has typed domain input/output but translates to protocol.Packet then delegates native messageWithFormatting under global mutex; protocol decoupling is a real seam to improve, independently of folder layout.
Room commands cross live room participation, persistent room controls, CommunityRole, linked rooms, identity existence/privacy, bot results and native packet dispatch.

Reporting authorizes either live room membership or durable private-group membership; operator review also administers room categories. Moderation crosses domain boundaries and needs explicit capabilities.

SaveMessage atomically validates group membership/block policy/photo ownership or room mute state, inserts message, immutable audience and request key. Domain splitting must retain transactionally consistent audience selection.

CreditOperationWithNote one transaction includes nonce replay, permission checks, credit debit/ledger, gift note, inventory and durable gift chat message/audience through saveGiftMessage. Naively calling commerce repo then messaging repo would break existing atomicity.
Gift authorization reads block list, identity privacy and contact graph inside the same debit transaction.

RegisterIdentity atomically consumes challenge and creates identity, roster and default Friends group. Explicit cross-capability consistency requirement; asynchronous roster setup would regress immediate login readiness.
LinkCommunityRoom validates both community role and room ownership under one transaction.

Public Catalog only needs public base origin and static product/emoticon/game metadata, no account/session/store state; low-risk service extraction example, though internal/catalog already owns static products.

candidate_modules.name: messaging

candidate_modules.name: rooms

candidate_modules.name: commerce

candidate_modules.name: legacy compatibility (technical module)
candidate_modules.boundary_warning: This is an adapter boundary, not a business bounded context. Gradually map it to typed application commands/results shared with modern API.

recommendation.approach: Incremental domain-oriented modular monolith in one Go module, one SQLite database, shared realtime state owner initially. Domain boundaries are candidates justified by responsibilities/invariants, not automatic by41-file threshold.
first_steps: Name and document capabilities, invariants and cross-module transactions; do not rename directories first.
Keep stable HTTP/controller and native compatibility facade. Extract typed policy/use-case functions that do not receive *Application or expose session maps.

Start with a narrow low-state capability such as public catalog, then typed read models/reports/commerce use cases behind consumer-owned ports. Keep identity credential/session synchronization explicit.
Reduce each extracted service dependency from ports.Repositories to only its required methods; move owned types next to capability gradually, retaining only truly shared primitives/errors centrally.
Leave DM/private-group/room/presence delivery coordination together until lock/ordering ownership is redesigned and validated; then extract room policy or state behind a single owner.
Keep sqlc-generated code and database/sql inside adapters; preserve specialized atomic operations for registration, message save and gift purchase across logical modules.
Add dependency/import guards between modules and focused tests that preserve transaction/locking/outbox invariants; retain original-client acceptance.
avoid: One domain package per source file or table
Giving each new service its own copy of session maps/mutexes
A shared god-package or interface exposing all124 repository methods to every module
Microservices, separate databases or separate go.mod files solely to reduce folder/file counts
Replacing current synchronous cross-feature transactions with in-memory events or sequential independent repository commits
Passing *sql.Tx or sqlc types through business service ports
Changing physical concurrency ownership in the same mechanical package move
